pkg.title: Fold the three Mistral variants into provider adapters of their base labs
pkg.scope: 07-application-agent-framework/agent-fundamentals/agent-core/** and 07-application-agent-framework/agent-fundamentals/mistral-agent-core/** (removed); 06-gateway/scaling-admission-cost/** (both labs and the topic README); 06-gateway/identity-security/agentic-identity-core/**, 06-gateway/identity-security/agentic-identity-core-mistral/** (removed) and 06-gateway/identity-security/README.md; the lines that name the variants in 06-gateway/README.md and 07-application-agent-framework/README.md (rows, run-it lines, caveats; Colab sections only via the generator), CURRICULUM.md and COMPUTE.md; tools/ci/labs.json; mkdocs.yml and COLAB.md only via their generators.
pkg.findings:
DECISION (approved): the three Mistral copies become provider adapters inside their base labs; the copies are removed. The review's analysis is tools/orchestration/reviews/2026-09-26-adversarial-review.md §7, second bullet (read it first). CLAUDE.md's rule stands — "vendor stacks are the same concepts worked per provider" — the change is that a provider is an adapter and one notebook, not a copy of the lab.

M1 AGENT CORE. `07-application-agent-framework/agent-fundamentals/mistral-agent-core/` is removed. `agent-core` gains: `agentcore/mistral_llm.py` (the adapter), `docs/MISTRAL.md`, the notebook `05_going_live_on_mistral` as percent-source under `notebooks_src/` built into `notebooks/` and `solutions/` (stable cell ids, the Colab cell), `tests/test_mistral_adapter.py`, and an optional extra `mistral` in `pyproject.toml` (the `mistralai` client). The default install and every T0 test need no key and no network; the notebook detects a missing key and stops with a labelled message (not a failure); exercise 5.3, which the review says tests recall of a model string, becomes a check of behaviour. Diff the two labs first (the review: 14 of 16 non-notebook files identical); carry over any improvement the Mistral copy had that agent-core lacks, and say so.

M2 SCALING LAB. `06-gateway/scaling-admission-cost/agentic-scaling-lab-mistral/` is removed. `agentic-scaling-lab` gains a backend switch: `scalelab/serving.py`, the fleet-sizing code and the vLLM/hybrid backends from the Mistral copy, selected by a parameter (and an environment variable for the notebooks) with the current default behaviour unchanged. The Mistral scaling primer `docs/01-scaling-primer.md` of the copy is a real rewrite (26% identical): keep it under `agentic-scaling-lab/docs/mistral/01-scaling-primer.md` with a one-paragraph note at its top on how it differs from `docs/01-scaling-primer.md`; the copy's other three docs are folded into the base docs only where they add material — list what was dropped. Both former test suites pass against the merged package (merge `tests/test_scalelab.py` cases; add tests for the switch); exactly one `pyproject.toml` declares `scalelab`, which ends the name clash recorded in CLAUDE.md's housekeeping (do not edit CLAUDE.md; the orchestrator will).

M3 IDENTITY CORE. `06-gateway/identity-security/agentic-identity-core-mistral/` is removed. `agentic-identity-core` gains `agentsec_core_mistral.py` rewritten to IMPORT the five moves from `agentsec_core.py` instead of copying them (the review: 230 of 401 lines verbatim), keeping the function-calling loop, the moderation screener and the per-agent keys; its three notebooks move beside the core's as `core_mistral_walkthrough.ipynb`, `core_mistral_practice.ipynb`, `core_mistral_solution.ipynb` (this package does NOT change the identity core's notebook layout — package c3 does that later; the Colab bootstrap cell must still be correct for the new folder: re-run `python3 tools/inject_colab_bootstrap.py` on it); `test_core_mistral.py` moves and passes; `requirements.txt` gains the Mistral client as an optional line or a `requirements-mistral.txt`; the README documents the optional Mistral path.

M4 NO STALE REFERENCES. Update the 06 and 07 layer READMEs (rows, run-it lines, caveats; regenerate the Colab sections), the two 06 topic READMEs, CURRICULUM.md (the module lines and any drill that names a variant), COMPUTE.md, tools/ci/labs.json (remove the three entries; the adapters' tests run inside the base labs' entries); regenerate mkdocs.yml and the Colab index. `python3 tools/orchestration/mdlinks.py` is clean on every changed .md. This grep over tracked files finds nothing outside CLAUDE.md and tools/orchestration/reviews/ (which you must not edit): `git grep -n -E 'mistral-agent-core|agentic-scaling-lab-mistral|agentic-identity-core-mistral'`.

M5 CI. `tools/ci/run_local.sh --check`, `tools/ci/run_local.sh agent-core`, `tools/ci/run_local.sh agentic-scaling-lab`, `tools/ci/run_local.sh agentic-identity-core`, `--notebooks`, `--colab-index` and `--docs` pass on your committed tree.

M6 READMES. The three base labs' READMEs follow tools/orchestration/README-STYLE.md and state the provider path in one sentence each (what the `mistral` extra adds, what runs without a key).
pkg.verify: In your own fresh venv, from the worktree root: (a) for each kept lab in scope, install it exactly as its README says and run `python3 -m pytest -q` in it; (b) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --check` (lab list complete, CI helpers tested); (c) `tools/ci/run_local.sh <lab-id>` for every lab id in scope that remains in tools/ci/labs.json; (d) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --notebooks` (every builder and the injector are no-ops on your committed tree); (e) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --colab-index`; (f) `tools/ci/run_local.sh --docs` (site generator tests, mkdocs.yml regenerated unchanged, strict mkdocs build, link check over all tracked Markdown) — read the usage comment at the top of tools/ci/run_local.sh first; (g) `python3 tools/orchestration/mdlinks.py <every .md you changed>`; (h) the stale-path grep named in the criteria; (i) `git status --porcelain` is empty after rebuilding notebooks and regenerating. Paste the tail of each result.
pkg.notes: agent-core and mistral-agent-core are percent-source (notebooks_src/ + tools/build_notebooks.py, BOOTSTRAP constant): merge the sources, keep stable cell ids, rebuild, and check the tooling tests (tests/test_notebook_tooling.py). The `mistralai` client may be installed in your venv to run adapter tests that need no key; no test may touch the network; no key exists here, so every provider path must degrade to a labelled stop. The identity labs are hand-written notebooks: use `python3 tools/inject_colab_bootstrap.py <lab-dir>` after moving them. Never install torch. Do not run `ipykernel install --user`. Package c1 is restructuring 07-application-agent-framework/long-running-durable/ in parallel — do not touch it, and do not touch the durable rows of the 07 README/CURRICULUM/COMPUTE.
